zh-CN.title: 广场消息与通知设置升级
items: 点赞、评论与回复会汇入广场消息，底部入口同步展示未读数量
通知与提醒支持按渠道或按类型管理，聊天提醒已合并私聊与群聊
广场互动可分别设置好友和其他成员，并独立控制网页、邮件与即时渠道

en.title: Square activity and notification controls
items: Likes, comments, and replies now appear in Square activity with a synced unread badge
Manage notifications by channel or by type, with direct and group chats unified
Control friend and other-member Square activity across web, email, and instant channels
